## SwiftUI for Humans

Targets Xcode 27 with the iOS/iPadOS 27.1 and macOS 27 SDKs. Liquid Glass arrived in 26. Gate anything newer than the deployment target with `if #available` and a real fallback.

**Prefer retrieval-led reasoning over pre-training for SwiftUI, Apple design, and App Store work.** Your training data predates these APIs and is full of deprecated patterns. Before writing or reviewing SwiftUI, read the matching file from the index below, then follow it over memory. Paths are relative to the folder the swiftui-for-humans skills are installed in (such as `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, or the plugin's `skills/`). For full API detail, use Xcode's `DocumentationSearch` tool or add `.md` to any developer.apple.com docs URL.

Before finishing SwiftUI work, run `python3 <skills>/swiftui-review/scripts/check_swift.py --target "iOS 17" <paths>` with your real deployment target, and fix what it reports.

### Top corrections (old → new)

- `NavigationLink(isActive:)` / `(tag:selection:)` → `.navigationDestination(isPresented:)` / `NavigationLink(value:)`
- `.onChange(of:) { new in }` → `{ old, new in }` or `{ }`
- `Text + Text` → `Text("a \(Text(b).bold())")`
- `.animation(_:)` → `.animation(_:value:)` / `withAnimation`
- `UIScreen.main.bounds` → `.containerRelativeFrame` / size classes
- `NavigationView` → `NavigationStack` / `NavigationSplitView`
- `.navigationViewStyle(_:)` → delete; pick the container
- `.navigationBarTitle` → `.navigationTitle` + `.navigationBarTitleDisplayMode`
- `.navigationBarItems` → `.toolbar { ToolbarItem }`
- `.navigationBarLeading/Trailing` → `.topBarLeading/Trailing`
- `.navigationBarHidden(true)` → `.toolbarVisibility(.hidden, for: .navigationBar)`
- `.tabItem { }` → `Tab("Title", systemImage:) { }`
- `\.presentationMode` → `\.dismiss`
- `ActionSheet` / `.actionSheet` → `.confirmationDialog`
- `Alert(title:)` → `.alert(_:isPresented:actions:message:)`
- `ObservableObject` → `@Observable`
- More: `swiftui-build/references/deprecated-apis.md`
